text: [XENIOS LAUNCH SPRINT HANDOFF] SESSION claude-fable-s6b-member-wall. TASK: catalog latency root cause + measurement, and the customer email half of P0-D. BRANCH lane/customer-order-email-truthfulness-20260821. BASE SHA 5144ae7fddaabd28aa6c1ed59371b15f31c4b84a. PUSHED SHA 004b4051b4b54ffd714cbca886062cfc5c3d02e4. ORIGIN VERIFIED: YES, git ls-remote returns 004b4051 for that ref. FILES: server/research/assisted-order/communications.ts + .test.ts (customer template only), server/research/early-access/catalog/projection-read-budget.test.ts (new, test-only). WHAT NOW WORKS: (1) THE 30-60s CATALOG IS EXPLAINED AND MEASURED. /research/early-access does NOT use the 3-query bulk/cached path. The bulk+cache+SWR work landed on the PRICING reader (CatalogPricingProductSource / catalog-price-projection); Early Access composes a DIFFERENT reader, ProductControlDeclaredFactsReader, never converted, and nothing on that path is cached. The fan-out spans three files which is why reading one function did not reveal it: declared-facts-source.ts:365 per product, :370 per variant, :386/:410/:444/:471/:502 per variant awaits; then member-catalog-service.ts inventoryFactsForVariant does ONE select from research_inventory_lots PER VARIANT and ONE rpc(research_lot_is_allocatable) PER LOT. Roughly (variants x select) + (lots x rpc) + per-variant holds. The new test measures it: 140x3 products = 420 inventory reads, 420 distinct variants; 5x2 vs 50x2 = 10 vs 100 exactly; and two identical projections cost 20 then 40, proving there is no cache. Each assertion is green today and documents what it should become after the fix, so going red IS the review moment. (2) Customer confirmation is now truthful: Order total, destination SUMMARY (city/region/country only), and Status: Order received, we have not charged you and nothing is reserved yet, then that Xenios will email availability and payment instructions. Four negative tests including one proving the customer template leaks no operator payload (phone, declared code, verified attribution, admin path, street) even when the payload carries all of them. TESTS: communications 16 passed, projection-read-budget 5 passed, assisted-order+outbox 210 passed, tsc clean. REMAINING RISK: the catalog fix itself is NOT done and is the launch blocker. member-catalog-service.ts is inside s7 CATALOG-ACTION-UNIFICATION so I did not touch it. The two changes: bulk lots read keyed by variant, and one set-based allocatable call replacing the per-lot RPC. The per-lot RPC is almost certainly the dominant term. Whoever does it must not let a successful EMPTY read replace a healthy snapshot - that exact bug was fixed once on the pricing lane at 15f436b. INTEGRATION INSTRUCTIONS: both changes are additive and test-only or renderer-only; no route, payload, migration or composition change. IMPORTANT - DO NOT INTEGRATE my earlier c9ee59e/293beb6 on lane/admin-order-email-completeness-20260821. I based those on 6291242 while s3 held the lease and origin head 5144ae7 already had the admin email done; they are duplicates and would conflict. This branch supersedes them and carries only the genuinely open half. PRODUCTION MUTATED: NO.
